coordinateSystem: glTF Y-up; layout computed in Blender space (x, y, z) -> three (x, z, -y)

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Global seed - same seed, same city, in Blender and in the browser

inputs.name: Max Inset
inputs.description: Max setback of a building from its lot edge (m)

inputs.name: Mega Block Chance
inputs.description: Chance a whole block becomes one megastructure

inputs.name: District Floor
inputs.description: Height multiplier of the quietest districts

inputs.name: Landmark Chance
inputs.description: Chance of a landmark tower (scaled by district)

inputs.name: Floor Height
inputs.description: Storey height; heights snap to whole floors (m)

inputs.name: Roof Clutter
inputs.description: AC units, tanks, antennas, dishes per roof

inputs.name: Facade Clutter
inputs.description: AC units, balconies and pipes per building

inputs.name: Billboard Chance
inputs.description: Chance of a giant LED screen on a tall building

inputs.name: Trim Chance
inputs.description: Chance a building is outlined in neon

inputs.name: Skybridge Chance
inputs.description: Chance of a skybridge across a street

inputs.name: Hologram Chance
inputs.description: Chance a landmark carries a hologram

inputs.name: Preview Blocks
inputs.description: Blender only: blocks per side in the viewport preview

inputs.name: Preview Origin X
inputs.description: Blender only: first block X - any window of the infinite city

inputs.name: Neon 1
inputs.description: Neon palette colour (instance attribute 'hue' indexes it)

inputs.name: Neon 2
inputs.description: Neon palette colour (instance attribute 'hue' indexes it)

inputs.name: Neon 3
inputs.description: Neon palette colour (instance attribute 'hue' indexes it)

inputs.name: Neon 4
inputs.description: Neon palette colour (instance attribute 'hue' indexes it)

inputs.name: Glass Inset
inputs.description: Curtain wall inset behind the pillars

inputs.name: Neon Slot
inputs.description: Neon strip running up the core

inputs.name: Taper
inputs.description: Top width relative to the base

inputs.name: Module Density
inputs.description: Protruding room modules per unit facade

inputs.name: Screen Width
inputs.description: Width of the vertical LED screens

inputs.name: Roofs
inputs.description: Flared eave roofs up the tower

inputs.name: Top Width
inputs.description: Width at the top (matches the GN setback)

inputs.name: Size
inputs.description: Width, depth, height of the hanging LED banner

inputs.name: Band Height
inputs.description: Height of the LED crown (fraction of roof width)
